selected_leaf: Construct and falsify a deterministic local transition model for Stage V routes A+B and B+C across pre-attempt, ambiguous-after-effect, positive-commit, negative-closure, retry and replay states, with UNKNOWN mutation-free except under true idempotent replay or after authoritative negative closure.

preserved_prior_findings.stage_u_checkpoint_before_effect: A canonical role-local STATE file updated by repository file-blob CAS and exact-read back can enforce PREPARED-before-effect ordering for one authorized transition, but repository CAS alone does not close the crash-after-effect-before-matching-commit-witness window for an arbitrary external side effect.
preserved_prior_findings.stage_v_minimal_target_contract: Stage V proposed B AND (A OR C), where A is same-logical-effect idempotent replay/correlation, B is authoritative positive committed-effect visibility, and C is authoritative negative closure for an ambiguous prior attempt; all target observations were required to correlate to the same logical_effect_id.

bounded_leaf_result.tested_scope: Deterministic local finite-state case analysis for at most two physical attempts of one logical effect after a durable PREPARED checkpoint. The model covers crash/restart and stale/reordered target observations for A+B and B+C routes. No concrete external target, public-source chain, or external mutation was invoked.

states.PREPARED: Durable checkpoint/readback exists before any target attempt.
states.UNKNOWN_k: Physical attempt k may or may not have committed; only read-only observation is allowed unless A authorizes same-key replay.
states.COMMITTED_k: Authoritative B witness for attempt k certifies positive completion.
states.CLOSED_k: Authoritative C witness proves attempt k cannot now or later commit.
states.READY_RETRY_k_plus_1: Reached only after CLOSED_k on the non-idempotent route; a new physical attempt may begin.

capabilities.A_idempotent_replay_correlation: Repeating the attempt with the same logical_effect_id cannot create a second logical effect and remains correlated to the same operation.
capabilities.B_authoritative_positive_visibility: A persistent authoritative positive witness certifies a committed effect and is correlated to the relevant operation identity.
capabilities.C_authoritative_negative_closure: An authoritative closure proves a specific ambiguous physical attempt cannot now or later commit.
capabilities.D_attempt_generation_identity_freshness: For non-idempotent retries, every B/C witness identifies the exact physical attempt generation and stale witnesses from generation k cannot authorize, close, or certify generation k+1. D may be implemented as an explicit attempt nonce/epoch or folded into strengthened attempt-scoped B/C semantics.

derived_contract.falsification: As Stage V defined B/C only at logical_effect_id correlation granularity, the B+C branch is insufficient under multiple non-idempotent retries with stale/reordered witnesses.
derived_contract.equivalent_strengthened_form: B* AND (A OR C*), if B* and C* are defined to include authoritative attempt-generation identity/freshness and stale-witness rejection for the non-idempotent branch.
derived_contract.strictly_new_requirement: D is strictly necessary only for the non-idempotent B+C retry branch unless its semantics are folded into B/C. No additional fourth capability beyond attempt-generation correlation/freshness was required by the tested two-attempt crash/reorder table.

bounded_leaf_result.unknown_mutation_rule: While attempt k is UNKNOWN, mutation is forbidden except a true same-logical-effect replay protected by A. Without A, a new mutation is authorized only after attempt-scoped C(k) and must use a fresh generation identity whose B/C witnesses cannot be confused with generation k.
bounded_leaf_result.direct_architecture_contribution: The direct Chat-native architecture is now checkpoint barrier plus one of two cross-system contracts: A+B for idempotent same-key replay, or B+C+D for serialized non-idempotent retries with authoritative per-attempt closure and witness freshness. This narrows the unresolved external requirement without treating an external executor or manual handoff as a solution.

provenance.semantic_source: own predecessor STATE plus deterministic local transition-system case analysis only; no public, O, downstream, other-worker, legacy, or shared-ledger semantic input

contradictions: If A permits the same logical_effect_id to create more than one logical effect, the A+B route is falsified.
If C(k) can be issued and attempt k may still later commit, the non-idempotent route is falsified.
If a B/C witness for generation k can be mistaken for generation k+1, B+C without D is unsafe under reordered observations.
If any new mutation occurs while the current attempt is UNKNOWN without A or prior attempt-scoped C closure, the mutation-safety invariant is violated.
If B is not authoritative and durable enough to be re-observed after crash, positive completion certification remains unresolved.
